svg.title: Every trial of CuaDriverBench on Omarchy 4.5, task by task: five squares per driver showing each seed's outcome (passed, driver limitation or AT-SPI/turn-limit failure) alongside median agent time on a log scale.
svg.text: Left: one square per seed (r1 to r5), coloured by outcome. Right: median agent time per task on a
log scale, further left is faster. A hollow dot marks a task where Cua Driver passed fewer than 3 of 5.
